changes.title: Guest station titles
items: Guest bedroom menus now say Wardrobe and Dressing table.

changes.title: Visit bed continuation
items: Your friend keeps moving normally when you start another night together.
If your friend leaves while you are asleep, you can wake up and use your bed again.

changes.title: Shared guest rooms
items: Both guest bedrooms open during a visit, with shared wardrobes, dressing tables and beds.
